title: Momentum Platformer
summary: Speed-building feel: gradual acceleration, long deceleration glide, and a high top speed where momentum matters more than instant stop-start.

runSpeed.whyItMatters: A high top speed is the whole point of a momentum platformer.
runSpeed.suggestion: Raise max horizontal speed toward 14 u/s.

runAcceleration.whyItMatters: A slow build rewards committing to a run rather than tapping.
runAcceleration.suggestion: Lower ground acceleration so reaching top speed takes a beat.

runDeceleration.whyItMatters: A long glide on release preserves momentum through level geometry.
runDeceleration.suggestion: Reduce ground friction so the player coasts after releasing input.

jumpApex.whyItMatters: A mid-height arc that carries horizontal momentum across gaps.
jumpApex.suggestion: Tune jump impulse so the apex sits near 3.5u.

timeToApex.whyItMatters: Enough hang to traverse at speed without floating aimlessly.
timeToApex.suggestion: Tune jump impulse and rise gravity so the apex is reached in ~0.38s.

maxFallSpeed.whyItMatters: A high terminal velocity lets the player convert height into speed.
maxFallSpeed.suggestion: Raise the fall-speed clamp toward 24 u/s.

coyoteTime.whyItMatters: A forgiving window keeps high-speed runs from punishing edge timing.

jumpBuffer.whyItMatters: Buffering keeps jumps reliable when reactions lag behind speed.
jumpBuffer.suggestion: Buffer a jump press for ~0.1s before grounding.
